policy: V28 registers the Financial OS accounting consumer for MetaPay distribution v3 evidence. It requires the exact v3 Plan/Auth/Ticket lineage and MetaPay BatchAttempt/SettlementReceipt/Utilization v3. Principal remains external-capital owner distribution; only actually incurred payer-borne fee is realized external expense. Historical accounting v1/v2 remain immutable.

additions.authority_note: MetaPay execution attempt evidence only; authorization consumed once; accounting authority NONE.
Terminal settlement evidence with exact principal and separately evidenced actual payer-borne fee. Financial OS remains accounting authority.
Exact aggregate settlement utilization; unused fee budget is unutilized authorized capacity, never profit.

Independent Financial OS decision over exact MetaPay v3 evidence. Settled principal is OWNER_DISTRIBUTION/EXTERNAL_CAPITAL/P&L-excluded; actual fee is OWNER_DISTRIBUTION_SETTLEMENT_FEE/EXTERNAL_EXPENSE/realized external expense.
